column1: # comment: "Calendar and scheduling alignments (calendar and scheduling design) \u2014 gmeow:Calendar, gmeow:EventSchedule, gmeow:EventInvitation, gmeow:Availability, gmeow:Reminder, gmeow:Task, gmeow:TimeZone and their value vocabularies, aligned to iCalendar (RFC 5545/5546), schema.org Schedule/EventSeries, and Wikidata by reference. VALUE VOCABULARIES: InvitationStatus, RsvpStatus, AvailabilityStatus, ReminderAction, TaskStatus, ExceptionType are gufo:QualityValue individuals, aligned to external classes/enums with skos:closeMatch (Principle 9 \u2014 no overtyping). SCHEDULE \u2260 OCCURRENCE: an EventSchedule generates Event occurrences; it is not the occurrence itself."

column6: iCalendar VCALENDAR is a projection target, not a peer model
schema.org RsvpAction — the invitation/RSVP social act
schema.org Schedule — a repeating schedule with exceptions
iCalendar VEVENT is the projection of a generated occurrence, not the schedule itself
iCalendar VTODO — a task is an event subtype with due date and status
iCalendar FBTYPE — FREE, BUSY, BUSY-TENTATIVE, BUSY-UNAVAILABLE
iCalendar PARTSTAT — NEEDS-ACTION, ACCEPTED, DECLINED, TENTATIVE
a generated occurrence is a sub-event of the schedule's series
the recurrence rule text projects directly to RRULE
schema.org repeatFrequency — a textual recurrence rule
iCalendar STATUS for VTODO — COMPLETED, CANCELLED, etc.
